study type: Secondary analysis of a multicenter randomized trial
exposure: CMQCC risk categories: low, medium, high
outcome: Intrapartum or postpartum red blood cell transfusion
finding: Three existing models for predicting blood transfusion during cesarean delivery demonstrated moderate performance in a large U.S. cohort, suggesting their external validity.
mod_finding: This study focused on predicting blood transfusion needs during cesarean delivery and did not examine different modes of delivery.
